commitments.review_question: Which dated readings, calibration records and site positions support this commitment?
Which threshold, exceedance record and response log can be matched?
Are repeat surveys comparable in extent, datum and timing?
Where is the dated plan and its implementation evidence?
Can placement logs be compared with contemporaneous monitoring?
Which approved method and field records apply to each work period?
Which plan revision governed the observed work?
Do inspections document controls at the relevant locations?
Can inspections and incident responses be matched to storage locations?
Which drainage plan and inspections demonstrate implementation?
